note: Both sets capture the same two figure values (pitch sensitivity at θ=0° and the 6.302336° angle) and both duplicate the pitch-sensitivity claim, and both omit the important definition that θK is the blade-pitch angle at which pitch sensitivity has doubled. Set A, however, misbinds 6.302336° as the 'best-fit line intercept', whereas the text states the intercept is the second term in square brackets of Eq. (7-16a) and 6.302336° is θK. Set B labels that value only as 'theta (θ)', which is vague but not misbound, so it makes no outright error. Neither set distinguishes θK from a generic θ, so both are weak on the defining condition.
